prompt:
You are an expert digital ASIC and FPGA Verilog design engineer.
Implement the module 'TopModule' satisfying the exact specification below.

SPECIFICATION:

I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  reset
 - output ena (4 bits)
 - output q   (16 bits)

The module should implement a 4-digit BCD (binary-coded decimal) counter.
Each decimal digit is encoded using 4 bits: q[3:0] is the ones digit,
q[7:4] is the tens digit, etc. For digits [3:1], also output an enable
signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be
incremented. Include a synchronous active-high reset. Assume all
sequential logic is triggered on the positive edge of the clock.



RULES:
1. Write clean, synthesizable, standard Verilog (IEEE 1364-2001/2005 or SystemVerilog 2012).
2. The module name MUST be 'TopModule'.
3. Output ONLY the module code enclosed in a ```verilog ... ``` code block.
4. Ensure all port names and bit-widths match the specification exactly.
raw_response:
```verilog
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    output reg [3:0] ena,
    output reg [15:0] q
);

    // BCD counter logic
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 16'b0; // Reset all digits to 0
            ena <= 4'b0; // Disable all enable signals
        end else begin
            // Increment the ones digit
            if (q[3:0] == 4'd9) begin
                q[3:0] <= 4'b0; // Reset ones digit
                ena[0] <= 1; // Enable increment for tens digit
            end else begin
                q[3:0] <= q[3:0] + 1; // Increment ones digit
                ena[0] <= 0; // Disable enable for tens digit
            end
            
            // Increment the tens digit
            if (ena[0] && q[7:4] == 4'd9) begin
                q[7:4] <= 4'b0; // Reset tens digit
                ena[1] <= 1; // Enable increment for hundreds digit
            end else if (ena[0]) begin
                q[7:4] <= q[7:4] + 1; // Increment tens digit
                ena[1] <= 0; // Disable enable for hundreds digit
            end
            
            // Increment the hundreds digit
            if (ena[1] && q[11:8] == 4'd9) begin
                q[11:8] <= 4'b0; // Reset hundreds digit
                ena[2] <= 1; // Enable increment for thousands digit
            end else if (ena[1]) begin
                q[11:8] <= q[11:8] + 1; // Increment hundreds digit
                ena[2] <= 0; // Disable enable for thousands digit
            end
            
            // Increment the thousands digit
            if (ena[2] && q[15:12] == 4'd9) begin
                q[15:12] <= 4'b0; // Reset thousands digit
                ena[3] <= 1; // Enable signal remains high if overflow occurs
            end else if (ena[2]) begin
                q[15:12] <= q[15:12] + 1; // Increment thousands digit
                ena[3] <= 0; // Disable enable for overflow
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
```
